scope: Proposition 5.4 (Actual-principal comparison) of the manuscript “Quantitative Near-Kerr Evolution and Generic C2 Future Inextendibility” (preprints/Quantitative-Near-Kerr-Evolution-and-Generic-C2-Future-Inextendibility-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 264 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cd38cc55e3c203a3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 51-52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each level (U, s, Ai) in (5.1), let dαβ M be the change from ḡ to g of the differential order-two wave coefficient in stationary normalization. On fixed compact reaches the reduced equation has the form Lp(t),c(t)U + dαβ M ∂αβU = Slin i + Serr i , Slin i = ±Q(∂t)bi, bi = a, a, a′ , (5.22) 51 up to common normalizations, where Serr i ∈ L1 Ai Hs−1 + L2 Ai Hs−1/2 , ∥Serr i ∥ ≤ CfixN2 + Cfixein. (5.23) On larger bounded differential annuli only L2 Ai Hs−1 is required. There is an actual-principal correction of the frozen energy whose additional integrated derivative errors are bounded in squared estimates by CfixN3, up to input terms. The frozen half-loss bulk and directional improvement remain on the left side of that estimate.
